title: 147873185 - 42-t-7585721-20060476F-001-005-2013
doc_notes: This document consists of internal NSC email correspondence and drafts of President Clinton's 1995 Christmas tree lighting speech in Belfast, which includes a humorous dismissal of the Roswell incident.

encounters.summary: President Bill Clinton addresses a letter from a 13-year-old boy named Ryan asking about the 1947 Roswell incident and the alleged recovery of alien bodies.
encounters.communication_content: Inquiry regarding the 1947 Roswell crash and potential U.S. Air Force cover-up of alien bodies.
encounters.quote: No, an alien spacecraft did not crash in Roswell, New Mexico in 1947.
